inputs.text:
Open your eyes to what is really happening behind the scenes. They are desperately trying to sell us the illusion of a simple court proceeding, but it is nothing more than a carefully engineered smokescreen designed to protect the machinery of control. On Tuesday, a Racine County jury delivered their scripted verdict after a two-day trial, convicting Harry Wait of two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft charge, while conveniently acquitting him of a second count of identity theft. 

The official narrative is completely inverted to hide the real coordination at play. Harry Wait leads a group that makes false election claims and admitted in 2022 that he requested the ballots to try to prove that the state’s voter registration system is vulnerable to fraud. Why are the hidden elites really punishing him? Because he dared to expose the exact vulnerabilities that they rely on to maintain their grip on the system. They are targeting him solely to send a chilling warning to anyone else who might dare to question the integrity of Republican state Assembly Speaker Robin Vos and Democratic Racine Mayor Cory Mason ballots. It is all a massive, coordinated manipulation orchestrated to keep the public in the dark.
